Coram : M.R. SHAH*, C.T. RAVIKUMAR
Penal Code, 1860 – s.302 r/w s.201 – Murder – Circumstantial evidence – Purported extra-judicial confession – Effect – Five accused including appellant (A-1) – Prosecution case that in pursuance of a conspiracy, the accused persons killed the deceased car – PW11 (Sub inspector) closed the case as undetected – However, case was subsequently re-opened and investigation initiated by police witness (PW30) on basis of confessional statement made in letter allegedly written by appellant to PW22 – Trial Court convicted appellant
Decision Date : 19-01-2023 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 466/2017 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
